rationale: Operator chose a (2026-11-27, full rubric). Problem: DEC-0430 b fixed the sync contract but nothing triggers a sync, so a remote backend's replica and the retrieval index go stale. Pick: optional sync()/status(), cli-context sync/status (AISDLC-1459), and a detached session-start sync only on a non-files backend, at most once per knowledge.syncIntervalMinutes (default 15), with queued/rejected counts and the last sync error on the session-start line (AISDLC-1460). Counter-argument: sync at every stop (as the enterprise asked) keeps the replica fresher; a survives because writes already reach the server immediately, sync only refreshes the local replica, and a per-stop sync would fully rebuild the index after every turn. Check: rebuild cost with an API embedder (unmeasured; 290 ms / 501 entries locally, enterprise figure). Undefined, specified in AISDLC-1459/1460: status() shape, stamp file, interval key. Provisional: Product (RFC-0053 OQ-2, amendment AISDLC-1458); enterprise RFC-0002 signers.
